name: REAL_LEFT_PGRIPPER_PROVISIONAL
what: Device profile of the LEFT gripper for sweepick_grasp.Jaw (the existing close / contact / hold primitive). It is about the gripper, not about an object: no opening of any object is in it. PROVISIONAL: one gripper, the selected slow profile, empty jaws (C) and one 40 mm block (PICK01).
units: ticks of the gripper servo; converted to the primitive's opening scale with the calibrated range of the device

residual_floor_ticks.basis: contact onset = the residual (measured - command) rises this far above the residual at the start of the same closing stroke, twice in a row. Free closing with empty jaws: residual 5 .. 11 (C, 2026-10-08) and up to 13 (free part of PICK01 close 1); 17 is the largest lead at which a free joint of this robot was seen standing (sweepick_progress_profile.json). The same value separates 'loaded' from 'relaxed' at rest: empty jaws rest 6 .. 7 ticks from the command

preload_residual_ticks.basis: the squeeze after the onset ends when the residual at rest reaches this: the floor plus the largest no-load residual at rest (7), so that a held object keeps the residual clear of the floor. In PICK01 the block was lifted and carried with the jaws only held at the contact position; no larger value is known to be needed

creep_step_ticks.basis: encoder resolution: one tick per squeeze increment

creep_period_s.basis: the existing primitive's period (residual read at rest in between)

close_rate.basis: the selected execution profile; the executor also limits the change of the rate by the profile acceleration

end_stop_ticks_above_closed.basis: the command does not go closer to the calibrated closed end than the contact floor, so the jaws' own end is not pushed

rest_step_ticks.basis: below one fifth of a tick per cycle the command counts as at rest

max_feedback_age_s.basis: five control periods; same as the existing primitive

not_in_here: no Load / Current threshold (raw units unverified; they are recorded next to the state)
the 125-tick lead and load 500 of PICK01 close 1 are not targets
